modifications: Scores: TensorFold's kernel computes each block score with per-lane fp32 fma and simd_sum (its own reference bits). mlx2 must reproduce its stock MLX chain (einsum of fp32 casts -> maximum -> sum over heads -> / sqrt(128) -> where), so qwen4_qsa_scores.block_scores runs MLX's non-NAX steel-GEMM element chain (simdgroup_multiply_accumulate over K in steps of 8 from a zero accumulator, BaseMMAFrag layout) on bf16 keys converted exactly in registers, then MLX's Maximum, the in-order head sum from the reduction identity, the fp32 scalar division and the select. Keys-stationary: a simdgroup holds all L*H query rows (<= 4 fragments) and reads each 8-block key fragment once for them; 64 blocks per 128-thread threadgroup. argpartition stays MLX (TensorFold has its own radix select; not ported).

Scores admission: Metal, MLX_ENABLE_TF32 off (TF32 routes the stock GEMM to NAX), head_dim 128, L*H <= 32, N > 128 blocks, batch <= 64 with an int or per-row integer offset array (the batched cache's left-pad path), bf16/fp16/fp32 operands; refusals counted by reason, the MLX chain runs. Prefill chunks (> 8 rows) are refused as 'rows'.

Window ids: mlx2 already keeps a decode/verify window's ids on the device and reads them at the PLE layer (verify-sync site qwen4.ple.ids_eval); the port adds only the async_eval of the hidden state before a PLE layer whose route reads host ids (NGramEmbedding.reads_host_ids mirrors __call__), within the eager-dispatch row bound.

Both behind FlashNextPolicy fields (default off, absent from env/receipts when off), kill switches qwen4_qsa_scores.set_enabled(False) / qwen4_exp.set_ple_early_dispatch(False), counters in diagnostics key tensorfold_longctx only when selected.
validation: CPU: tests/test_tensorfold_longctx.py (12 tests: policy opt-in/receipt-neutral/strict, diagnostics key, scores admission + counted fallback with the stock selection kept, stock chain vs numpy, PLE dispatch order + identical outputs, row-bound decline, reads_host_ids vs the route actually taken).

Metal kernel: scripts/check_qwen4_qsa_scores.py -- 96/96 cases (rows 1/2/3/4/8 x contexts 8.2K..128K x 3 seeds incl. duplicated-block ties) and, after forcing the loops unrolled (the L >= 3 build was 3-15x slow without it), 36/36, plus batched 4-row array-offset cases at 16K/32K/64K: scores bytes and argpartition ids identical.

Metal real layers: scripts/check_tf_longctx_layers.py on Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Uncensored-MLX2-4bit-MTP -- trunk layers 3/23/47 + MTP head, 16K/32K/64K, widths 1/2/3, plain / batched / left-padded two-row caches: 108/108 cases with selected ids, attention output and K/V byte-identical, fused scores engaged on all 432 compared calls (qualification/runs/tf-longctx-20261001/layers2.json).

Full model (scripts/bench_tf_longctx.py, in-process rotated arms, 256 greedy tokens, real docs+code prompts): greedy tokens identical to base in every run. qsa_fused_scores paired median [range]: B1 MTP on 16K +0.5% [-2.5,+2.9], 32K +1.6% [+0.8,+2.9], 64K +2.2% [-0.3,+3.2] (8 reps); B1 MTP off 16K -2.1% [-3.8,+4.0], 32K +2.6% [+1.5,+3.4], 64K +9.0% [+3.4,+14.8]; 4 lanes 32K MTP off (scores+ple) +2.7% [+1.4,+3.7], MTP on +1.0% [-0.8,+4.3]. ple_early_dispatch: -3.3%..+1.5% paired medians, no reliable gain (qualification/runs/tf-longctx-20261001/README.md).
selection: 2026-10-01: qsa_fused_scores selected as the Flash-Next default by Pierre (exact; B1 MTP on +1.6% at 32K, +2.2% at 64K; MTP off +2.6% at 32K; 4 lanes +2.7%). ple_early_dispatch stays opt-in (no reliable gain). Not qualified until the next requalification.
